legal_principles.principle: An act of abetment may take place in one of three ways: instigation, conspiracy, or intentional aid.
legal_principles.held: Section 107 defines abetment. It is well known that an act of abetment may take place in one of three ways:

legal_principles.principle: The charge which the accused persons were called upon to meet was that they had taken part in the celebration of the marriage.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, the charge which the aforesaid accused person were called upon to meet was that they had taken part in the celebration of the marriage.

outcome.final_order: The Revision Petition filed by the petitioners has been dismissed.
